title: 2026 continuous stack monitoring, LTS and PEMS QA controls

sources.title: Monitoring stack emissions: standards for continuous monitoring and sampling

facts.source_fact: The guidance covers quality assurance for CEMS and DAHS, long-term samplers and predictive emissions monitoring systems.
facts.expected_handling: Classify the monitoring system before selecting standards.

facts.source_fact: Flow CEMS calibration uses EN 16911-2 in conjunction with EN 14181.
facts.expected_handling: Require both flow-calibration and CEMS-QA standard context.

facts.source_fact: Mercury CEMS calibration uses EN 14884 in conjunction with EN 14181.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve mercury-specific calibration standard and QA context.

facts.source_fact: Particulate CEMS calibration uses EN 13284-2 in conjunction with EN 14181.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve particulate-specific calibration and QA standards.

facts.source_fact: The current calibration standard for dust-arrestment plant monitors is EN 17389.
facts.expected_handling: Use EN 17389 rather than the superseded standard for current records.

facts.source_fact: EN 14181 covers certification, calibration and ongoing quality assurance and applies to all determinands measured with CEMS.
facts.expected_handling: Require EN 14181 QA context across CEMS determinands.

facts.source_fact: Ongoing quality assurance and control of DAHS uses EN 17255-4.
facts.expected_handling: Treat DAHS QA separately from analyser calibration.

facts.source_fact: Long-term samplers provide continuous samples over periods typically 2 to 4 weeks while the process operates.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the averaging period with LTS results.

facts.source_fact: Each LTS sample is analysed in a laboratory and yields a single time-averaged result over the sampling period.
facts.expected_handling: Do not represent LTS results as instantaneous readings.

facts.source_fact: Dioxin, furan and dioxin-like PCB LTS uses isokinetic sampling, extraction and gas chromatography-mass spectrometry analysis.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the sampling and analytical chain.

facts.source_fact: Dioxin-related LTS averaging periods typically range from 14 to 28 days.
facts.expected_handling: Require the sampling-period metadata.

facts.source_fact: The relevant long-term sampling standard for dioxins, furans and dioxin-like PCBs is CEN TS 1948-5.
facts.expected_handling: Use the correct pollutant-specific LTS standard.

facts.source_fact: Mercury LTS uses paired sorbent media traps with laboratory analysis.
facts.expected_handling: Record trap configuration and laboratory method.

facts.source_fact: The mercury LTS technique measures total vapour-phase mercury including elemental and gaseous oxidized forms.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mislabel the measurement as total mercury across all phases.

facts.source_fact: Mercury long-term sampling uses CEN TS 17286, which covers performance criteria and ongoing system evaluation.
facts.expected_handling: Carry standard and performance-evaluation status.

facts.source_fact: Biogenic CO2 LTS uses time-integrated samples over averaging periods typically 28 days.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the averaging period for biogenic-carbon results.

facts.source_fact: Biogenic CO2 analysis may use accelerator mass spectrometry, liquid scintillation or beta ionization after flow-proportional sampling and extraction.
facts.expected_handling: Record the selected analytical technique.

facts.source_fact: There is no published LTS monitoring standard for biogenic CO2; the guidance allows applying principles of periodic manual method CEN 13883.
facts.expected_handling: Do not claim a dedicated published LTS standard where none exists.

facts.source_fact: PEMS predicts real-time emissions from models relating emissions to continuously available process parameters.
facts.expected_handling: Label PEMS values as model-derived rather than direct stack measurements.

facts.source_fact: The relevant monitoring standard for PEMS is CEN TS 17198.
facts.expected_handling: Require PEMS standard provenance for model-based monitoring.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach CEMS, DAHS, LTS or PEMS system type before applying standards.
Carry monitoring standard, averaging period and laboratory/model status.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents invalid comparison of instantaneous and time-averaged results.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry source URL, publisher and monitoring standard into outputs.
Do not convert stack-monitoring method rules into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
